_comment: Hoenn spot overrides (notable-spots spec, authored overrides). add: {map, x, y, facing (DIR_*), kind: bench | center_side}. drop: {map, kind} drops a whole detected place; {map, x, y[, kind]} drops one spot. ignore_objects: {map, local_id} objects the walker graph treats as passable (story blockers the simulation outlives). script_warps: {map, warps: [warp ids]} warp events on tiles without a warp behaviour that a script fires (graph.py takes only warps that can fire).

ignore_objects.what: Wally at the Mauville Gym door
ignore_objects.why: Story blocker on the Gym door's only approach tile, present at New Game. The Gym's own leader is home-locked until the player holds the badge, which needs this blocker gone, so the static walker graph treats it as passable.

ignore_objects.what: Invisible Kecleon on the Route 120 bridge
ignore_objects.why: Story gate (Devon Scope, FLAG_HIDE_ROUTE_120_KECLEON_BRIDGE) on the only path between Route 120's north half (Fortree) and its south half (Route 121, Lilycove). Treated as passable so Hoenn's east is one walker region.

ignore_objects.what: Kecleon's shadow on the Route 120 bridge
ignore_objects.why: The bridge Kecleon's shadow object on the same tile; removed with it.
Present at New Game until the Kecleon scene (FLAG_HIDE_ROUTE_120_STEVEN), next to the bridge Kecleon on the same one-tile-wide path; part of the same story gate.
Story blockers (FLAG_HIDE_ROUTE_121_TEAM_AQUA_GRUNTS, gone after Mt. Pyre) standing in the only gap between Route 121's west half and Lilycove's side. Treated as passable, with locals 13 and 14.

script_warps.what: Petalburg Gym's room doors and room entrances
script_warps.why: Each room's door is a sign event (PetalburgCity_Gym_EventScript_*RoomDoor) that runs warpdoor once VAR_PETALBURG_GYM_STATE reaches 6, and the door scripts set each room's entrance tiles to METATILE_PetalburgGym_RoomEntrance_* (MB_SOUTH_ARROW_WARP). On the static map both are plain floor, so these warps are listed as firing: they are the only way from the lobby to Norman's room.
